jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About WorkWhile
WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. 83 million Americans work hourly jobs, often with unpredictable schedules that pay close to minimum wage and offer limited benefits, leading to financial instability.

WorkWhile identifies the best hourly workers and matches them with shifts that fit their skills, location, and life. Businesses get access to a quality workforce, while workers get stable income and unmatched benefits, including next day pay, free telehealth services, and financial services.

We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work.

About the Role
WorkWhile is looking for an experienced Account Executive with a proven track record of success to join our rapidly growing team. This role is responsible for strategic new business sales and expansion. As an Account Executive you will manage all aspects of the sales process including prospecting, lead management, qualification, customer evaluation, closing new business, and expansion. This role will be focusing on the light industrial, hospitality, and retail verticals.

The ideal candidate must have an entrepreneurial mindset, a hunger for success, and a consultative customer-centric approach.

  • Demonstrate a strong business case for WorkWhile through a consultative and value-driven sales process

  • Establish a collaborative business relationship between WorkWhile and key decision makers within target accounts

  • Meet and exceed your goals through prospecting, qualifying, managing, and closing new sales opportunities

  • Partner with account management, operations, and sales development teams to drive revenue

About you

  • 3-5+ years of sales experience in a quota carrying, closing role

  • Experience in enterprise sales.

  • A track record of success – consistently exceeding quota

  • Experiencing breaking down accounts to identify multiple decision makers

  • Strong presentation and communication skills with the ability to influence others over the phone/Zoom

  • Strategic and creative thinking that enables you to understand industry and customer trends and apply those insights to deliver business results

Benefits & Perks

  • Hybrid work culture with office hubs in SF, NY & Toronto

  • In-person company offsites

  • Medical, dental, & vision coverage

  • Flexible time off

  • 401(k)

  • WFH stipend to support your home office needs

Target Hiring Range: $100K– $150k per year base salary

This range represents the good-faith estimate of the base salary/wage we reasonably expect to pay at the time of hire. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including experience, skills, and geography.

Additional Compensation:

  • Commission: This role is eligible for commission.

  • Equity: This position is eligible for [RSUs/Stock Options] as part of our long-term incentive program.

    WorkWhile is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. WorkWhile has a diverse, mission-driven, and supportive culture—we look for people who want to take ownership, are energized by ambiguity, and strive to make a lasting impact. If this resonates with you, we’d love to chat!

jobs.title: Corporate Controller
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About WorkWhile

WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. More than 80 million Americans work hourly jobs - often with unpredictable schedules, near-minimum wages, and few benefits - leading to real financial instability. We're fixing that by matching enterprise customers across logistics, food production, retail, hospitality, events, and managed services with a quality hourly workforce, while giving workers stable income and unmatched benefits like next-day pay, free telehealth, and financial services.

WorkWhile is evolving from a high-growth temporary labor marketplace into a comprehensive workforce platform for enterprises with fintech offerings workers. The result is a multi-business-model company with a genuinely complex, interesting financial landscape.

Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work.

The Opportunity

This is not a "maintain the books" Controller role. This is a build-it role.

As Corporate Controller, you'll serve as the CFO's right hand in architecting a world-class accounting function from the ground up - one capable of supporting high-volume transaction processing, multi-stream revenue recognition (Marketplace + SaaS + Fintech), and banking-level treasury operations. You'll lead an ERP migration, deploy AI-driven automation, and own the technical accounting for business models that most Controllers never get to work across simultaneously.

If you're a technically deep CPA who wants to do more than close the books - someone who wants to shape financial infrastructure at a venture-backed, mission-driven company - this role is built for you.

What You'll Own

1. Core Accounting Operations

  • Full-cycle accounting ownership: General Ledger (GL), Payroll, Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Record-to-Report (R2R)

  • Data integrity: Partner with Data Science to ensure financial data in the ERP (NetSuite/Intacct) aligns precisely with operational data sources (BigQuery, Metabase)

  • High-volume payroll: Manage complex weekly and daily payroll runs for a nationally dispersed workforce, with distinct treatment for W2 employees (taxes, benefits, withholdings) and 1099 independent contractors

  • Month-end & year-end close: Own the close calendar, drive down close cycle times, and ensure a clean, audit-ready general ledger at all times

2. Technical Accounting & Compliance

  • Revenue Recognition (ASC 606): Author technical accounting memos and policy for multiple evolving revenue streams - including "Principal vs. Agent" gross-to-net calculations for marketplace revenue and subscription revenue recognition for the Newday SaaS product

  • Fintech & Treasury Accounting: Build accounting workflows for WorkWhile Wallet and W2 Early Pay - including daily liquidity management for payroll funding, high-volume card transaction reconciliation (Marqeta, Stripe), and accounting for potential credit losses on worker advances

  • Equity & Stock-Based Compensation: Manage equity plan administration and ASC 718 accounting

  • Multi-jurisdiction Tax Compliance: Oversee federal, state, and local tax filings; manage payroll tax nexus across all states where W2 workers operate; address sales tax implications for SaaS products

3. Audit & External Reporting

  • Audit leadership: Own the external audit relationship end-to-end - drive the first company financial audit, prepare PBC schedules, manage fieldwork, and deliver audited financial statements on time

  • Investor & lender reporting: Prepare accurate, well-documented financials for board reporting, debt covenant compliance, and future fundraising due diligence

4. Systems, Automation & Team Leadership

  • ERP migration: Lead the evaluation and implementation of a scalable ERP upgrade, including integration with billing, payroll, and payments systems

  • AI & automation: Proactively identify and deploy AI agents for reconciliation, invoice processing, and anomaly detection - reducing manual workload and improving accuracy

  • Collections & DSO optimization: Strengthen billing and collections processes, managing invoicing nuances across Enterprise and SMB client segments

  • Team development: Manage and mentor the internal accounting team and oversee the offshore BPO team, ensuring seamless collaboration across time zones

What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications

  • Active CPA license - non-negotiable

  • Big 4 accounting firm experience: Minimum 4-6 years in audit at a Big 4 firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, or KPMG), serving public company or high-growth technology clients

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 3 years as a Controller or Assistant Controller at a venture-backed technology company

  • Deep technical accounting expertise in ASC 606 revenue recognition, including multi-element arrangements and gross vs. net revenue treatment

  • Proven track record of ERP implementation - specifically migrating from QuickBooks to NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or equivalent

  • Experience managing multi-state payroll tax compliance and nexus analysis for a company with a distributed workforcePreferred / Bonus Qualifications

Preferred / Bonus Qualifications

  • Industry experience in Marketplace, Fintech (lending, ledgering, prepaid cards), or SaaS business models

  • Hands-on experience with Stripe, Marqeta, or similar payment processors from an accounting and reconciliation standpoint

  • Experience managing hybrid onshore/offshore accounting teams or BPO relationships

  • Exposure to SQL, BigQuery, or BI tools (Looker, Metabase) for financial data analysis

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Are the kind of person who investigates a variance until it's fully explained - not just deemed immaterial

  • Can translate complex accounting positions (like Gross vs. Net revenue) clearly for non-finance stakeholders, investors, and lenders

  • Are energized by ambiguity and want to build, not just maintain

  • Have a strong bias for action and take pride in operational excellence

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + equity in a high-growth, venture-backed company

  • Hybrid work culture with office in SF

  • In-person company off-sites

  • Medical, dental & vision coverage

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 401(k)

  • WFH stipend to support your home office setup

WorkWhile has a diverse, mission-driven, and supportive culture—we look for people who want to take ownership, are energized by ambiguity, and strive to make a lasting impact. If this resonates with you, we’d love to chat!

jobs.title: Head of GTM Strategy and Ops
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About WorkWhile

WorkWhile is the AI-native labor platform modernizing the frontline economy. Our digital marketplace connects vetted, reliable hourly workers with on-demand shifts across major verticals like logistics, light industrial, warehousing, hospitality, and retail. Businesses get access to a quality workforce, while workers get stable income and unmatched benefits, including next day pay, free telehealth services, and financial services.

We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work.


The Role

We’re building the commercial engine that takes WorkWhile from strong-but-ad-hoc to a repeatable, data-driven growth machine - and this role is the strategic and operational core of it. Reporting directly to the Chief Business Officer, you’ll be our right hand on GTM strategy and operations: the person who turns a scaling revenue org into a cohesive operating system that produces predictable, defensible growth.

This is a builder’s seat, not a maintainer’s. You’ll inherit a small, capable team and grow it into three functions - operations for our new-business (AE) motion, operations for our expansion (AM/CS) motion, and systems & tooling - while personally owning the hardest strategy and modeling problems yourself. And because we’re a two-sided marketplace, your forecasts and plans have to reconcile demand (pipeline, quota, conversion) with supply (fill rate, worker reliability, capacity): a number we can’t fill isn’t a number. If you’re energized by ambiguity, love both the whiteboard and the SQL query, and want your fingerprints on how a category-defining company scales, this is a rare one.

What you’ll own

  • The revenue operating system. Own the end-to-end GTM cadence - weekly forecast, monthly and quarterly business reviews - and deliver a single, methodology-backed forecast leadership and the board can act on. Build it to reconcile demand-side pipeline with marketplace supply and fill, so the number is one we can actually deliver.

  • GTM strategy & motion design. Drive the highest-leverage commercial bets: segmentation and named-account focus, intent capture, outbound and conversion levers, pricing and packaging recommendations, and deal desk. Codify what our best sellers and account managers do into a motion the whole team can run.

  • Planning & performance. Partner with Finance to design fair, motivating incentive structures tied to the behavior we want - profitable growth and durable expansion, not just volume. Partner with Finance and pod leads on territory design, quota-setting, and capacity modeling, and build the account-level forecast the business plans against.

  • Systems, data & AI. Own the GTM tech stack (Salesforce, Nooks, Gong, Hightouch, Clay, and our BI layer) and the pipelines and dashboards beneath it. Embed AI across the funnel - account scoring, enrichment, intent, call intelligence, and routing - so the team spends its time where it converts and our data stays clean enough to trust.

  • Cross-functional leadership. Be the connective tissue across Sales, Account Management, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Marketplace Operations - representing GTM’s priorities and translating between the commercial number and the marketplace that has to fill it.

  • Team building. Recruit, coach, and scale a high-performing team across the three RevOps functions, and set the roadmap for how Strategy & Operations supports the company’s growth.

What success looks like

In your first 6–12 months, you’ll have stood up a forecast the board trusts, shipped an incentive plan aligned to profitable growth, replaced spreadsheet heroics with a real operating rhythm across our Top-20 and expansion accounts, and gotten our data and systems clean enough that decisions come from one source of truth.

About You

This is a high-bar role, and we’ve tried to be honest about what actually predicts success here rather than pile on filters. You likely bring most of the following.

  • Must-haves

    • 7+ years in Revenue, Sales, or Business Operations or GTM Strategy, including building and leading teams (roughly 3+ years managing).

    • You’ve helped scale a high-growth business through a comparable inflection - think roughly $20M to $100M+ in revenue - in a marketplace, workforce, or B2B SaaS environment. Two-sided marketplace or workforce-platform experience is a plus, because supply-aware GTM is a different game.

    • Strong, hands-on analytical ability: you get into the data yourself (SQL and BI/dashboards, e.g., Metabase) to model, diagnose, and pressure-test - not just direct others to.

    • Deep fluency with the modern GTM stack - enough Salesforce and systems-architecture judgment to design, audit, and lead the build (a systems & tooling lead reports to you for hands-on administration).

    • An AI-native operator: you’ve used predictive/AI and prompt-engineered tools (Claude, Clay, and the like) to remove operational drag and create leverage.

    • A collaborative, high-velocity, low-ego style, with the executive presence and crisp written communication to earn trust with the sales floor, the C-suite, and the board alike.

    Nice-to-haves

    • Prior quota-carrying or customer-facing experience (empathy for the teams you support).

    • Experience standing up RevOps or forecasting in a business moving from ad hoc to systematized.

    • Exposure to capital-linked unit economics (receivables, margin) or regulated/frontline labor.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive base salary and bonus

  • Equity

  • Hybrid work culture with office hubs in SF, NY, Seattle & Toronto

  • In-person company offsites

  • Medical, dental, & vision coverage

  • Flexible time off

  • 401(k)

  • WFH stipend to support your home office needs

WorkWhile has a diverse, mission-driven, and supportive culture—we look for people who want to take ownership, are energized by ambiguity, and strive to make a lasting impact. If this resonates with you, we’d love to chat!

WorkWhile is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities and protected veterans are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Last Mile, Logistics & Warehousing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Account Manager – Last Mile, Logistics & Warehousing

About WorkWhile

WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. 83 million Americans work hourly jobs, often with unpredictable schedules that pay close to minimum wage and offer limited benefits, leading to financial instability.

WorkWhile identifies the best hourly workers and matches them with shifts that fit their skills, location, and life. Businesses get access to a quality workforce, while workers get stable income and unmatched benefits, including next day pay, free telehealth services, and financial services.

We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work.


Role Summary

WorkWhile is looking for an Account Manager to join our Last Mile, Logistics & Warehousing pod and build long-term, trusting relationships with our clients. This role is focused on managing a portfolio of accounts - from last-mile delivery providers and 3PLs to warehouse, distribution, and e-commerce fulfillment operators - ensuring they have the right forklift operators, pickers and packers, and drivers to keep operations running smoothly, especially during peak seasons, volume surges, and new site launches.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, driving satisfaction, retention, and growth while acting as a strategic partner who understands the fast-paced, throughput-driven nature of logistics operations.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the lead point of contact for all account management matters for your clients, including staffing planning, escalations, and ongoing strategy

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with site and warehouse managers, operations and fleet leaders, safety managers, HR leaders, and other key stakeholders

  • Develop a deep understanding of each client's operating environment - including shift patterns, volume forecasts, delivery routes, equipment and certification requirements, and safety standards - to proactively meet their workforce needs

  • Maintain and grow client contracts, identifying upsell and expansion opportunities across new sites, shifts, markets, or job categories (e.g., forklift operators, pickers and packers, and drivers)

  • Develop trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, aligning WorkWhile's solutions to their operational goals and labor challenges, such as turnover, absenteeism, and overtime costs

  • Ensure timely and successful fulfillment of shifts and workforce solutions in line with client expectations and SLAs

  • Communicate the progress of weekly, monthly, and quarterly workforce initiatives clearly to both internal teams and client stakeholders

  • Forecast and track key account metrics including fill rates, worker performance, client satisfaction scores, and revenue growth

  • Prepare regular account health reports and business reviews tailored to operations leadership

jobs.title: Field Marketer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About WorkWhile

WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. 83 million Americans work hourly jobs, often with unpredictable schedules that pay close to minimum wage and offer limited benefits, leading to financial instability.

WorkWhile identifies the best hourly workers and matches them with shifts that fit their skills, location, and life. Businesses get access to a quality workforce, while workers get stable income and unmatched benefits, including next day pay, free telehealth services, and financial services.

We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work.

WorkWhile is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

About the Role

We’re looking for our first Field marketer at WorkWhile. You'll own our field program end to end: which events we do, what happens before and after each one, and the target-account programs that run alongside them. Every event should produce a measurable contribution to pipeline, and you'll own that number.

We aren't just looking for traditional playbooks. We want someone who actively leverages AI productivity and automation tools to execute, test, and scale campaigns. You’ll thrive here if you love a fast-paced startup environment, possess a strong bias for action, can turn scrappy ideas into reality, and are obsessed with tracking pipeline ROI.

You’ll report directly to the Head of Marketing (B2B) and work closely with Sales, Account Management, Product, and Data Science to ensure our campaigns translate into revenue. You'll operate as an individual contributor with end-to-end ownership of your domain.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a mission-driven team at an inflection point. Your work will directly accelerate our growth and help shape WorkWhile’s demand gen strategy from the ground up.

What you’ll do

  • Run events as campaigns, not moments: Own pre-event meeting booking, on-floor engagement, and post-event follow-up as one connected program, and turn field engagement into opportunities and deal acceleration.

  • Choose the event mix: Decide what's worth doing, from sponsoring industry conferences to hosting our own dinners and roundtables. Score every event on audience fit, cost, and expected return before we say yes, and use what you learn to decide which ones to repeat.

  • Run account-based field programs: Build programs for one account, a few accounts, or many, matched to open deals and target accounts, hand in hand with Sales, SDRs, and AMs.

  • Arm Sales with proof: Build the case studies, one-pagers, and competitive material that move deals, and keep the customer story current as we expand into new verticals.

  • Build with AI, not just use it: Find the manual parts of the event workflow, from invite list enrichment to follow-up drafting, and build tools and templates that speed them up. Build the ones the rest of the team picks up too.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience: 4+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or integrated marketing at a B2B company, ideally growth-stage with a sales-led motion. You've owned trade show and conference programs end to end. Experience marketing to a non-technical operational buyer is a strong plus, and logistics, staffing, hospitality, manufacturing, and facilities backgrounds all translate. Willing to travel for events.

  • Campaign-oriented: You treat every event as one part of a campaign, with outreach before and follow-up after, not something that ends when the booth comes down.

  • Audience & account-driven: You become an expert on the target accounts. You understand their priorities, their buying committees, and their signals well enough that Marketing is a strategic advantage for Sales.

  • π-shaped: Deep craft in field and events, with real working competence in product marketing and growth.

  • High quality bar: You get the people, the place, and the programming right so every event stands out, starting with who's in the room.

  • AI user, with judgment: You use AI to speed up the event busywork, from invite lists to post-event follow-up, and you check what it drafts before it goes out.

  • AI builder: You find a manual workflow and build a tool or template that removes it, rather than doing it a third time.

  • Multiplayer AI builder: What you build gets adopted by others, so the field program scales without adding headcount.

  • Sets & hits goals: You own event-sourced pipeline end to end and make the calls on which events to cut and which to scale.

  • Team orchestrator: You keep Sales, SDRs, and AMs ahead of what's coming and clear on what they need to do.

  • Velocity: You set direction with limited guidance, test new formats quickly, and find new communities and partners where our buyers already are.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + equity in a high-growth, venture-backed company

  • Hybrid work culture with office hubs in San Francisco.

  • In-person company off-sites

  • Medical, dental & vision coverage

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 401(k)

  • WFH stipend to support your home office setup

WorkWhile has a diverse, mission-driven, and supportive culture—we look for people who want to take ownership, are energized by ambiguity, and strive to make a lasting impact. If this resonates with you, we’d love to chat!
